method.scope: Independent accounting/concentration inspection of prior saved paths only; no new prices, no orders, no new strategy selection.
method.capital: Every path starts once at USD500, all subsequent daily/monthly results inherit preceding cash; no restarts or contributions.
method.concentration_counterfactual: Subtracting a winning trade or symbol contribution is arithmetic attribution with all later saved quantities unchanged. It is NOT a rerun with that trade removed and is NOT an executable alternate wealth path.
method.monthly: Jan-Sep2026 are nine complete months; Oct1-Oct5 is partial and excluded from positive/negative full-month counts.
method.dependence: All paths share the same historical window, universe, signals and execution model. Cost scenarios and classification sensitivity are not independent trials; identical reversal paths repeat exactly.
method.result_status: Exploratory retrospective sensitivity on already studied data, never forward validation.

interpretation.concentration: At most one position already deploys available cash subject to integer shares. Increasing concentration requires changing symbol ranking/holding horizon or leverage, not simply reducing a diversified portfolio. Higher concentration is not supported by these fragile returns alone.
interpretation.holding_horizon: Multi-day holds can test whether one-day liquidation loses trend continuation and can reduce turnover. Predeclare horizons and signal-ranking variants; use exact entry/exit cash accounting, mark daily equity including open positions, prevent impossible overlapping full-capital trades, and test adverse gaps and end-of-window residual positions.
interpretation.cost: 10bp to25bp scenarios change later integer quantities and skipped days, so terminal differences are not pure fee subtraction. Breakout gains fail the higher-cost scenario.
interpretation.selection: Preserve all models including losers. Compare predeclared families; oldJan-Oct data can support exploratory chronological diagnostics but cannot become untouched or forward evidence after model development. Future observations after freezing rules are required for forward verification.
limits: Current directory is not a historical point-in-time universe; survivorship and missing inactive-symbol history remain.
Daily OHLC next-open/same-day-close model does not establish actual fillability, cash settlement eligibility, or intraday extrema of equity.
Equity returns cannot validate option profits, especially without historical contract bid/ask, IV, spread, multiplier and expiry.
